My goal now is to get the salvage pipeline running again, this time ensuring the Python path includes the repo root (`/home/lane/MythosMini`). The simplest fix is to prepend an import and a `sys.path.insert(0, "...")` line at the top of the script. I can do that in-place with `sed -i`, inserting the two lines before the existing content.

After fixing the script, I need to launch it in the background again, redirecting its output to `/tmp/salvage.log` so I can monitor progress. A short sleep (20 seconds) will give the process time to start and produce some initial log output. Finally, I’ll pull the last few lines from the log to verify that it started without immediate errors.

All of this can be done in a single Bash command: first the `sed` insertion, then the `nohup` launch with output redirection, echo the PID, pause, and then `tail` the log. I’ll set a generous timeout (40 seconds) to cover the sleep and log tailing.
